children: none, because the two halves are one defect -- the device walk skips on a DIRECTORY and passes instance 0 always, and both are the same missing precision about what the unit of wiring is. Splitting them would leave `cairn cc.1 restart` resolving to nothing even after ticket 55fc9263bf5a teaches the dispatcher to read the address.
watchme: none, because Akien answered Q#75 on 2026-11-09 (outline 5.4.3.3.1): "why the hell would it need a heartbeat?" Most instance bins are links to their class bin, so a new verb is reachable the moment its file lands, and D6's proof is the whole guarantee; probes fire on events, never the beat (outline 5.9).

launchers/intention+why.json.why: a21aa887 (ticket 38125c3ada38) moved launchers/ to the devices that own them: the bootstrap floor and its charter, including the launch contract, went to cairn/devices/recovery. The 2026-09-22 constrain packet predates that move.
